# T-2: Track repair evidence validity

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create the bounded repair fingerprint and append-only repair audit that invalidate mismatched downstream evidence before retesting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fingerprint inputs and exclusions match R3.
- Every repair ledger entry contains the R2 audit fields.
- Artifacts from test-execute through acceptance-review record the current fingerprint and mismatches are invalidated.
- Bound overflow and truncated fingerprints fail closed.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse the existing bounded EvidenceFingerprint pattern where possible, but keep repair ledger semantics in a deep flow module. Invalidation must preserve plan artifacts and tests while retaining existing downstream step resets.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests cover fingerprint equality/change, path bounds, ledger invariants, exact invalidation range, and consumer rejection; CLI coverage proves regeneration after repair.
